references.text: Moses received advice from Jethro to teach the people the laws and statutes and show them the way they should go and the deeds they should do.
Moses told the people all the Lord's words and all the laws, and the people answered with one voice that they would do everything the Lord had said.
Moses taught the Israelites the statutes and laws that the Lord had commanded him, so that they might live by them in the land.
Moses urges the people to listen and keep all the words he commands them, so that it may go well with them.
These are the commandments and statutes that the Lord gave to the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab.
Paul declares that he has not held back from proclaiming the whole counsel of God, just as Moses proclaimed all God's commands to Israel.
